note: Self-assessment by the developer for the owner; not legal advice. Source: docs/compliance/gdpr.md. Statuses: compliant, partial, open.

controls.requirement: Health data processed only with explicit consent
controls.evidence: Consent at sign-in and a separate health-data consent; terms v17 accepted and recorded (acceptances, text fingerprint)

controls.requirement: Privacy notice names the controller (name, address, contact)
controls.evidence: Gap G1: the owner's name and postal address are missing
controls.next: Human gives name/business name and address

controls.requirement: Only the data needed: no name, no email, no documents
controls.evidence: Google account as HMAC only; lab documents never leave the phone; only report date and values as printed; logs without values

controls.requirement: Each kind of data kept only as long as its purpose needs
controls.evidence: Blood pressure 365 days (nightly purge); lab results until the user deletes them (purpose: complete history, user-controlled); errors and events 90 days; sessions and links 7 days
HTTPS/TLS only (Cloudflare, TLS 1.3 when supported); every app request signed with a key kept on the phone; replay protection

controls.requirement: Stored data protected against unauthorised access
controls.evidence: Only the Worker reaches D1; Anthropic keys AES-GCM; codes, cookies, links and files as fingerprints. Health values are not field-encrypted and D1 disk encryption is not stated in Cloudflare's documentation we checked
controls.next: Decide whether to encrypt lab and pressure values per account

controls.evidence: D1 database bound to the EU jurisdiction; the Worker may run at a Cloudflare edge outside the EU (stated in terms and privacy, gap G4)
controls.next: Regional services (paid) if required after legal review

controls.evidence: Anthropic (monitor photo only) and Google (sign-in, billing) named with DPF/SCC; lab documents are never transferred
Gap G11: Cloudflare DPA acceptance on the account not yet confirmed
controls.next: Human confirms in the Cloudflare account

controls.evidence: Web Dashboard shows all data, PDF of lab results and 7-day pressure report; no single machine-readable export of everything (G5)
controls.next: "Download all my data" (JSON/CSV) in the Web Dashboard

controls.requirement: Delete single data, all data, the account
controls.evidence: Readings, a lab date, all lab results, a report, or the whole account, immediately; acceptance record kept on legitimate interest
Draft kept in docs/compliance/gdpr.md section 5, updated with lab results

controls.requirement: DPIA for health data at scale
controls.next: Claude drafts from the threat model, Human signs

controls.requirement: Notify the authority within 72 hours, users if high risk
controls.evidence: Gap G10; emergency switch-off of all apps exists (app_off)
controls.next: One-page procedure (who notices, decides, notifies FDPIC / Garante)

controls.requirement: Representative in the EU for a Swiss controller
Only technical cookies, after consent, declared
controls.evidence: One cookie (hint_s) after consent; the app uses none; declared in terms and privacy

controls.requirement: The owner never sees values, reports or names
controls.evidence: Admin shows totals and codes only; observability without values
No judgement or advice; the orange ↑/↓ only repeats the comparison with the reference printed on the report
controls.next: Legal review before the Play Store

controls.requirement: Known vulnerabilities found and fixed in time
controls.evidence: Nightly OSV/Semgrep/gitleaks scan, Dependabot, deadlines by severity; see the Security console
